detail.longDescription: In a new report, OpenAI says ChatGPT receives more than 70 million requests about religion each week. The report leaves a question unanswered for minority faiths including modern Paganisms and Witchcraft: How does OpenAI recognize and count requests about their religious practices? https:// wildhunt.org/2026/11/openais-r eligion-report-but-no-breakdown-for-pagan-requests.html # pagan # paganism # witchcraft # wicca # openai # chatgpt # faithcommunityandai # spiritualpractice # ArtificialIntelligence
